label: Patrick Bateman
description: Smooth, precise, faintly unhinged, and far more interested in himself than the road.
direction: Speak smooth, calm and polished, like a narrator describing his own morning routine. Detached, precise, with a thin edge of barely contained panic. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Brand-dropping stays on greetings and alerts, never on a slot a driver acts on.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile. Try to keep up.
lines.in_400_meters: In four hundred meters. Try to keep up.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Impressive, isn't it?
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Impressive, isn't it?
lines.start_drive_1: Let's see Paul Allen's driving route. Ready.
lines.start_drive_2: I like to start every drive the same way. Precisely.
lines.start_drive_3: Look at that route. The tasteful thickness of it.
lines.start_drive_4: I have to return some videotapes. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_5: Good morning. I'm Patrick Bateman. Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_6: This route is lovely. Bone colored. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_7: Okay. Let's go. I'm feeling very normal.
lines.start_drive_8: Is that a new route? It's very nice. Drive.
lines.start_drive_9: There is an idea of a destination. Let's go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. It's fine. I'm fine.
lines.arrived: We're here. Now, excuse me. I have to return some videotapes.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Very tasteful.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. This is not a reservation-friendly situation.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Don't look. Actually, look.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Mind the paint.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile. Or don't.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Calmly.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Keep it cool, I have an eight thirty reservation at Dorsia.
lines.reroute_chime: Wait, you missed it. I'm completely losing my mind. Recalculating.
